name: ranktitan-local-seo
description: Local SEO rank tracking and ranking heatmaps for Google Business Profiles.

interface.shortDescription: See where a business actually ranks on Google Maps across its city — and who is taking the space it is missing.
interface.longDescription:
Rank Titan tracks how local businesses rank in Google's map pack. This plugin brings that into the chat.

Two tools need no account at all: audit any business's Google profile and see what it is missing, or find out who really ranks for a local search, with ratings and review counts. Useful for a prospect, a competitor, or your own listing before you sign up for anything.

With a Rank Titan account you also get your own data: the locations you manage, the map-pack positions Rank Titan last measured for each tracked keyword and when, a full profile audit, the reviews still waiting for a reply, and the ability to publish a reply to Google from the conversation.

And the one local SEO is really about: a live ranking grid. Pick a business and a search, and it measures where you rank from 19 points spread across the area — which is how you discover you are first at your own door and invisible three miles away. It reports your average position, how much of the area holds a top-3 spot, and the competitors holding the rest.

Rankings are stored measurements, not a live scan, and every answer says when they were last taken. A grid is run on request and is the one metered action: one free run per account.

Sign-in is through the same Google account you use for Rank Titan, so there is no key to paste and no password for this plugin to see.
